caption.instagram:
A cheaper policy raises your deductible by €2,000. When do premium savings catch up?

The part of a claim you pay yourself is the deductible, and raising it lowers the premium. In the lesson's example, moving it from €500 to €2,500 saves €300 a year. Seven claim free years save €2,100, a little more than the extra €2,000 one large claim would cost.

The catch is timing. A claim in the first years arrives before the savings have built up, so the extra has to come from cash already set aside. That is why people who raise a deductible tend to do it once their reserves could absorb it, and why it suits cover where claims are rare.
